ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity predominance with an estimated 75-80% white pixel coverage across the ventral surface, contrasted by low-intensity black margins and a dark central vertical column.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) regions occupy the majority of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) contiguous regions are localized at the trailing edge margins, the outer terminal tips, and a vertical stripe originating from the median notch extending toward the peduncle. Sparse, low-intensity micro-blobs are detected on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and a significant depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serrations identified along the entire trailing edge. Notable high-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixels depth) are concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe, while the left lobe exhibits more moderate, irregular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve fitted to the inner trailing edge leading from the median notch to the outer tips; overall lobe shape presents a symmetrical upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of four distinct, roughly parallel, vertical high-contrast dark lines (rake marks) on the distal region of the right lobe. Additional unaligned, diagonal dark linear disruptions are visible on the upper-central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent odontocete-style rake marks on the right lobe; irregular, high-contrast pigmentation patterns at the base of the fluke near the water line indicating potential old scarring or tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific pattern of four vertical rake marks on the right lobe provides a unique spatial identifier not shared by standard pigmentation patterns.
